Simon Shanks (2nd from left) and Gary Budinger (3rd from left) line up for the start of a colts 1500 metre race at Norbiton track.

"Right, who's next" - Some of the Belgrave lads stand prepared to take on all-comers. Left to right: Gary Budinger, S.Watts, Mark Shippen, Robert Bashford, Steve Walters, Gary Wallace, David Didino and Ivan Beaumont.

Apart from these three, Gary Budinger put up the best total in all eight events. Several of the boys are not yet 12 years old and will still be eligible for the maximum allowances next year including Simon Shanks who was a very creditable 6th.

Many Belgravians have already been struck by the aggressive running of 13 years old Gary Budinger. He likes nothing better than to run an 800 metre race as hard as he can, pulling all the stops out from the gun and ensuring that if anyone is going to beat him they'll have had to make a hard race of it.
Two regulars in action this winter past. Left - Gary Budinger. Right - Simon Holmes.

Tony Ambler ran well in 4th position, putting behind him Steve Walter[illegible] and Toby Staff, who both looked a little uncomfortable over the country and missing the track. 1st Boy: Adrian Cook. 1st Colt: Gary Budinger.

Gary Budinger was at one point seen ploughing along waist deep! All our boys seemed to find the heavy going more than they bargained for but perhaps Stevie Walters, with just that little more experience of running than the others was the least affected as he led our Youth team in.
Cross Country Race at Crowborough over 3 miles. In the Wandsworth District Schools race over 2¾ miles Gary Budinger crossed the line a very creditable 3rd.
A Colts race was held in conjunction and who should pop up once again but Gary Budinger with a tremendous run that took him well clear of the next runner.
